WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.608284 35.498511)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1300 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH arboretum_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-82.608284, 35.498511), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
high_elevation_areas AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(arboretum_geom.geom, 4326))
),
elevation_raster_clipped AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(high_elevation_areas.rast, true, ST_Transform(arboretum_geom.geom, 4326)) AS rast
  FROM high_elevation_areas, arboretum_geom
),
elevation_above_1300 AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_MapAlgebraExpr(elevation_raster_clipped.rast, 'rast.val > 1300 ? rast.val : NULL')) AS rast
  FROM elevation_raster_clipped
),
nearest_distance AS (
  SELECT ST_Distance(arboretum_geom.geom, ST_Transform(ST_Union(elevation_above_1300.rast), 4326)::geography) AS distance_meters
  FROM arboretum_geom, elevation_above_1300
)
SELECT ROUND(distance_meters) AS distance_meters
FROM nearest_distance;
